author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI let you fulfill your childhood dreams.

I am a hardware engineer by trade, but over the years, I had dreamed about working as a software guy, writing games, trading in an investment bank, as a manga artist, etc.

There is NO way I can find time to do all of these in pre-AI era.   Now with the help of AI, I just need to burn enough tokens to pretend to be a semi-decent worker in all of those jobs.   Since I genuinely interested in those topics, AI can even help me BS way beyond my level.

The scare part is, no one can tell you are just pretending and BSing or that is your real day job.
